pcs.pc_description: use suitable ppe like rubber hand gloves and nose mask as required
ensure the place/room is clean, ventilated and well lit
select suitable lacquer based on hue and tone of object and customer requirement
transfer lacquer (varnish) in a clean bowl
dilute with volatile thinner to make solution of suitable consistency
mix the lacquer and thinner well with a stirrer
check the mixture by sample testing on suitable materials to ensure it matches with the shade/finish required
ensure the object is clean, smooth and free from dust, dirt etc.
ensure the object is not damp or wet
apply lacquer to the object uniformly as per finish required
check the coating and if needed apply second coat and allow to dry
continue applying lacquer and drying till desired level of shine/finish is attained
